```yaml
name: Check

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@6b8b3b
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@c3b5f
        with:
          rust-version: stable

      - name: Install just
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://just.systems/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Setup project
        run: just setup

      - name: Run checks
        run: just check
```

yaml:
name: Check

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@6b8b3b
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@c3b5f
        with:
          rust-version: stable

      - name: Install just
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://just.systems/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Setup project
        run: just setup

      - name: Run checks
        run: just check
